meta.name: wait-what
meta.description: Stop. That last message did not land — re-pitch it.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把没说清的话重新组织，让对方一次听懂
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常发完消息才发现别人没接住
copy.tagline_en: Rephrase unclear messages so they land at once
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often realize after sending that your point didn't land

howto.what: 装上后,触发时 Claude 会表示没跟上最后一条消息,要求对方重新说明:补充一点背景、改用 ASD-STE100 简化技术英语、并遵循 CONTEXT.md 中的统一术语。
howto.when: 此技能设了 disable-model-invocation,不会自动触发;需你明确叫“wait-what”才会使用,常用于上一条消息没讲清时。

say.text: 请用 wait-what 技能回应我刚才那句话。
say.note: Claude 会停下,要求你重新说明。

say.text: 我刚才没讲清楚,请用 wait-what 提示我补充背景。
say.note: 它会请你给点上下文再重讲。

say.text: 按 wait-what,让我用简化英语重新说一遍。
say.note: 它会要求你改用简化技术英语。

howto.what_en: When triggered, Claude stops and says it didn't follow the last message, then asks you to re-pitch: give a little context, use ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, and use the ubiquitous language from CONTEXT.md.
howto.when_en: This skill has disable-model-invocation true, so it won't auto-trigger; you must explicitly ask for “wait-what”, typically when your last message wasn't clear.

say_en.text: Please respond to my last message using the wait-what skill.
say_en.note: Claude will stop and ask you to re-pitch.

say_en.text: I didn't make that clear — use wait-what to prompt me for context.
say_en.note: It will ask you for a bit of background first.

say_en.text: Use wait-what so I re-state in Simplified Technical English.
say_en.note: It will ask you to switch to STE.
